resolutions.researcher_notes: UPDATES (does not merely carry) the v2 __VALIDITY__ on this row. TWO OF THE THREE v2 CONCERNS ARE NOW RESOLVED. (1) LENGTH 825.00 km — PROVENANCE FOUND. The v2 note said no source reproduced the sheet's figure; the 2011 大江网/新浪 report does, verbatim, of the Phase I network as a whole ('管道全长825公里'). Recommend KEEPING 825.00 km. The remaining spread is definitional, not a correction: 553 km (2008-08 chyxx, announced plan, carried from v2), 680 km (2008-10 sohu, design length at groundbreaking), 825 km (2011 sina, sheet), 870 km (2014 provincial DRC plan, as-built, 6 trunks + 1 branch), 876 km (petrobest, 干线总长度), ~1,600 km (2025 SSE, PLANNED Phase I incl. all branches). If the orchestrator wants an as-built figure rather than a 2011 figure, 870 km (DRC plan) is the best candidate — but that is a value change and is NOT recommended without human review. (2) COST 3,100,000,000 RMB — PROVENANCE FOUND, and the v2 conflict was a misreading. The same 2011 report gives '预计总投资31亿元' for the network. The v2 note's competing '1.691B RMB (2022 audited, incl. branches, CCXI)' is NOT a network total: re-read in context, CCXI 2022 Table 2 is 在建长输管道情况 (projects UNDER CONSTRUCTION as of 2022-03), where 一期管网工程（含支线）总投资 16.91亿 / 累计投资 16.06亿 covers only the leftover Phase I branches still being built. That conflict should be struck. Remaining, and genuinely different: sohu 2008 '项目总投资近26亿元' (groundbreaking estimate, and it bundles the CNG mother stations with the pipeline network), and SSE 2025 134亿元 for the combined Phase I + Phase II 3,400 km programme (a two-phase system aggregate that must never be staged on any single row). Recommend KEEPING 3.1bn RMB, tier medium. (3) STILL OPEN — StartYear1 2009 vs 2010. petrobest says the 九江-南昌 and 九江-景德镇 trunks were built and supplying gas in 2009 and that the network was 全线贯通 in 2010; sohu 2008 planned end-2009 completion; sina 2011 shows the 丰城至抚州段 only reaching 试投产 in August 2011. So the network has a 2009 first-gas, a 2010 full-through and a 2011 last-section date, and no document states a single commissioning year. This is the parent-level face of the same cluster RELAUNCH_NOTES §5 flags on P4779/P4780 — adjudicate the parent and the two trunks together, do not change one in isolation. (4) INFORMATIONAL, network-size drift across the two rating reports: CCXI 2022 gives the rated group 1,402 km of long-distance network with 48.5亿立方米/年 of throughput at 2022-03, while SSE 2025 gives 3,182 km built / 2,892 km in service for the whole programme at 2024-03. Neither is a Phase I figure; recorded so a future pass does not mistake either for one.

resolutions.researcher_notes: SETTLED in v2 and RE-CONFIRMED by this pass's documents: P4777 is the Phase I NETWORK PARENT row, deliberately co-existing with its constituent segment rows (P4776, P4778-P4784, P5859, P5862, P5864-P5866, P5886, P5889). Do NOT fold it into its segments and do NOT treat the overlap as duplication. Two naming sources independently describe Phase I as a single named engineering project with an aggregate length, cost and design capacity of its own — the 2014 provincial DRC plan ('江西省天然气管网一期工程已建成管道 870 公里，主要建成九江一南昌、九江-沙河、九江-景德镇、南昌-丰城、高安-新余、丰城-抚州 6 条干线和田南-上高支线') and petrobest ('干线总长度876公里') — which is exactly the parent-plus-segments shape GEM already models. The practical rule this pass followed, and that the orchestrator should keep: network-level totals (825 km, 3.1bn RMB, 5.7 bcm/y, the 54/46 ownership) belong on P4777 and must not be copied down onto segments; segment figures (DN508 on 樟树支线, 6.3 MPa on 湖口-金砂湾, 2.60 bcm/y on 九江-景德镇) must not be promoted up onto P4777 — which is why Diameter and Pressure are left UNRESOLVED here despite consistent segment-level evidence.
